beats: The gate opens only enough for one body.
Fresh ash preserves the last returning footprints.
A child’s ribbon is tied to the route marker.

reactions.fear_high: No one volunteers to walk first.
reactions.hope_high: A hero reties the ribbon so it remains visible.

beats: The bell is heard through bones before ears.
Scratches inside the rubble answer every strike.
The rescued refuse to ring it until all names are counted.
Bronze nameplates shine where rain uncovered them.
One plate bears no family name.
Enemies have arranged three plates around a cold fire.
The lift rope was cut from above.
Medical wrappings mark a survivor route.
Restoring the lift opens a permanent shortcut.
Tournament poses are carved beside civic oaths.
The bodies were buried with tools, not weapons.
The Témoin repeats a promise using several dead voices.

lines: Keep the weapon side clear. I can bind the rest while we walk.
Ambidextrous or not, a two-handed weapon still needs two arms.
Rest hid the pain; it did not heal it.
We leave it untreated, it follows us into every room.
That fear will save us once and provoke them the next time.
Saying no is still a decision the Sanctuary must live with.
We may find the cost of that refusal further down the road.
Give me time and clean hands. We do not need the Infirmary for this.
I can treat every wound. A lost limb is another matter.

documents.title: Charte des trois disciplines
documents.text: Every citizen cultivates a body capable of restraint, a mind capable of creation, and a voice answerable to the common good.

documents.title: Minutes of the last open council
documents.text: Several delegates insist the disaster was not equally sudden everywhere. Others accuse them of inventing intention where panic and incomplete reports may be enough. The council records the disagreement without deciding it.

documents.title: On useful fear
documents.text: Fear is a witness. Listen to it, but never let it pass sentence.

documents.title: Notes from an unstable room
documents.text: Three witnesses heard a fourth voice. None agreed on its words. Exposure records are attached; no conclusion about illness, truth or origin is justified by this note alone.

documents.title: Hope as maintenance
documents.text: Hope is not certainty. It is the work repeated before certainty exists.

chapter_1_may_establish: the current Fall does not explain every older trace associated with the Veil
witnesses can disagree about anomalous events
survivors already suspect several competing explanations
chapter_1_must_not_establish: organized foreign responsibility for the Fall
observer participation as a proven Veil mechanism
the ultimate ontology of the Veil
